title: A cocontinuous and continuous functor satisfying five conditions induces an equivalence of topoi
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter sites.tex (Sites and Sheaves)

difficulty_reason: The lemma gives sufficient conditions on a functor between sites for the associated morphism of topoi to be an equivalence: cocontinuity, continuity, two conditions allowing morphisms between images to be lifted and compared after a covering, and the condition that every object is covered by images of objects (statement lines 6990-7015). The proof is a complete argument: it reduces to showing that the two adjunction maps are isomorphisms (proof lines 7017-7039); the counit is handled by describing the composite as a limit over a category with an initial object and proving uniqueness and existence of the components using conditions (4) and (3) (proof lines 7040-7084); and the unit is handled by identifying the composite on objects of the form u(U) and using condition (5) to reduce every object to such images (proof lines 7086-7103). The non-formal content is the use of the covering conditions to control the limit. The claim is H2: a structured argument with every hypothesis used explicitly.
